name: v289_eval_quality_minus_contract_cashflow

expression: 0.27 * (trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(-1 * vec_avg(earnings_evaluation_sentiment), 5), 180), industry), -1)) + 0.23 * (0.5 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.5 * rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126))) - 0.30 * (0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales_growth, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1))) + 0.20 * (0.325 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_acqgdwl / assets, 126), industry) + 0.125 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.200 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry))

expression: 0.32 * (group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry)) + 0.19 * (0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(sales_estimate_standard_deviation / abs(sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(sales_estimate_count_quarterly, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_30_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)) + 0.15 * (0.40 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(common_stock_buyback_payments / cap, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)) - 0.34 * (0.6 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_profit_before_depr_amort / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.4 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry))

expression: 0.12 * (0.5 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.5 * rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126))) + 0.25 * (group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry)) - 0.32 * (0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 252) / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)) + 0.31 * (0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales_growth, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1)))
